statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if, for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c. Thus r is true exactly when the sentence contains at least one occurrence of each lowercase English letter from 'a' (97) through 'z' (122), and r is false otherwise.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: The function returns a result r: it does not fail, panic, or encounter an out-of-bounds index or arithmetic overflow on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = false, there exists a byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 such that for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), sentence[i] != c. That is, at least one lowercase English letter does not occur in sentence.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true, len(sentence) >= 26.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and len(sentence) < 26, r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if there exists a byte c such that for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), sentence[i] = c, then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122 there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c, then r = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.

statement: If, for every byte c with 97 <= c <= 122, there exists i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c if and only if there exists j with 0 <= j < len(sentence2) and sentence2[j] = c, then whenever the function returns a result r for sentence and a result r2 for sentence2, r = r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122; for the other slice sentence2, 1 <= len(sentence2) <= 1000 and every byte of sentence2 is in 97..122.

statement: If every lowercase byte that occurs in sentence also occurs in sentence2 (formally, for every c with 97 <= c <= 122, if there exists i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c then there exists j with 0 <= j < len(sentence2) and sentence2[j] = c), then whenever the function returns a result r for sentence and a result r2 for sentence2, r = true implies r2 = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122; for the other slice sentence2, 1 <= len(sentence2) <= 1000 and every byte of sentence2 is in 97..122.

statement: Let sentence2 be the slice obtained by appending c to the end of sentence. Whenever the function returns a result r for sentence and a result r2 for sentence2, r = r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; every byte of sentence is in 97..122; c is a byte with 97 <= c <= 122; len(sentence) < 1000; c occurs in sentence (there exists i with 0 <= i < len(sentence) and sentence[i] = c).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if exactly 25 distinct byte values c with 97 <= c <= 122 occur in sentence (that is, exactly 25 different lowercase English letters have an occurrence), then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(sentence) <= 1000; for every index i with 0 <= i < len(sentence), 97 <= sentence[i] <= 122.
